description_en: Queries Destination Network Address Translation (DNAT) entries that you created
description_zh: 调用DescribeForwardTableEntries查询已创建的DNAT条目
name: DescribeForwardTableEntries

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT entry
parameters.name: forward_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The EIP in the DNAT entry. The public IP address is used to access the Internet
parameters.help_zh: DNAT条目中提供公网访问的弹性公网IP地址
parameters.name: external_ip

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the instance that uses the DNAT entry for Internet communication
parameters.help_zh: 通过DNAT条目进行公网通信的实例的私网IP地址
parameters.name: internal_ip

parameters.help_en: The name of the DNAT entry
parameters.name: forward_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol. Valid values:

TCP: forwards TCP packets.

UDP: forwards UDP packets.

Any: forwards all packets
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型，取值：

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。

UDP：转发UDP协议的报文。

Any：转发所有协议的报文
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为100行。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

ExternalIp.description_en: The EIP in the DNAT entry. The public IP address is used to access the Internet
ExternalIp.description_zh: DNAT条目中提供公网访问的弹性公网IP地址

ExternalPort.description_en: The external port or port range that is used in port forwarding
ExternalPort.description_zh: 进行端口转发的外部端口或端口段

ForwardEntryId.description_en: The ID of the DNAT entry

ForwardEntryName.description_en: The name of the DNAT entry

InternalIp.description_en: The private IP address of the instance that uses the DNAT entry for Internet communication
InternalIp.description_zh: 通过DNAT条目进行公网通信的实例的私网IP地址

InternalPort.description_en: The internal port or port range that is used for port forwarding
InternalPort.description_zh: 进行端口转发的内部端口或端口段

IpProtocol.description_en:
The protocol. Valid values:

TCP: forwards TCP packets.

UDP: forwards UDP packets.

Any: forwards all packets
IpProtocol.description_zh:
协议类型，取值：

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。

UDP：转发UDP协议的报文。

Any：转发所有协议的报文

NatGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the NAT gateway

StandbyExternalIp.description_en: The secondary EIP that is used to access the Internet
StandbyExternalIp.description_zh: 提供公网访问的备用弹性公网IP地址

StandbyStatus.description_en:
The status of the secondary EIP. Valid values:

Running

Stopping

Stopped

Starting
StandbyStatus.description_zh:
备用弹性公网IP的状态
Running：开启
Stopping：关闭中
Stopped：关闭
Starting：启动中

Status.description_en:
The status of the DNAT entry. Valid values:

Pending: The DNAT entry is being created or modified.

Available: The DNAT entry is available.

Deleting: The DNAT entry is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
DNAT条目状态，取值：
Pending：配置中，可能是创建中或修改中。
Available：可用。
Deleting：删除中

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
